snippet.title: Hunter's Trophy 2 Europa PC Gameplay HD 1080p
snippet.description:
MORE TO COME SO PLEASE SUBSCRIBE - mtvkriar91 - IF YOU LIKED VIDEO HIT 'LIKE' THANKS !!

Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/DaliCafe

Follow us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/CafeBarDali

Settings maxed out to ultra
Vsync off
Averaged fps while recording video

To watch in best quality just click on the quality tab and choose '1440p'

PC Specs:
MB Gigabyte GA-Z68XP-UD4 B3 dual bios 
CPU Intel i7 2600K 3.4 GHz (oc to 4.4 GHz)
GPU Asus GeForce GTX-580 Direct CU II (oc to 911 Mhz)
RAM Corsair Vengeance DDR3 8gb 1600Mhz
PSU XFX 850w Black Edition 
SSD OCZ 128GB Vertex IV 128GB
HDD WD Caviar Black 2TB 64MB 6gbs 7200rpm
HDD WD Green 1TB 64MB 3gbs 7200rpm
CASE Thermaltake Chaser MK-1 Full Tower
COOLER Corsair H80 Liquid Cooler with 2 x120mm stock fans push/pull rear intake
FANS Thermaltake 4x230mm multi color led -1 front intake - 2 top out - 1 left side panel intake
MONITOR Samsung SyncMaster XL2370 LED 23"
KEYBOARD Logitech G15
OS : Windows® 7 64-bit

*No animals were harmed during the making of this video.
